mapper.select: SELECT uc.user_coupon_id as userCouponId, uc.coupon_id as couponId, uc.status, uc.get_time as getTime, c.name, c.type, c.amount, c.min_point as minPoint, c.start_time as startTime, c.end_time as endTime FROM user_coupon uc LEFT JOIN coupon c ON uc.coupon_id = c.coupon_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.status = 0 AND c.start_time <= #{currentTime} AND c.end_time >= #{currentTime} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.amount DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE user_coupon SET status = 0, use_time = NULL WHERE user_coupon_id = #{userCouponId} AND status = 1
UPDATE user_coupon uc LEFT JOIN coupon c ON uc.coupon_id = c.coupon_id SET uc.status = 2 WHERE uc.status = 0 AND c.end_time < #{currentTime}
